# Beacon recovery manual

## Checkpoint protocol

Beacon checkpoint protocol uses a local durable journal.

During recovery, operators inspect the last committed record before proceeding. The device stays isolated from external services. | State | Action |
| --- | --- |
| committed | reuse recorded output |
| uncertain | require reconciliation |

## Telemetry

Telemetry stays on the device.
